title: First Universaarl item controlled write gate
purpose: Create or cleanly block exactly one first Universaarl item after TARGET-040 proved the relevant item and inventory pages read-only.
entryCriteria: TARGET-040 observed Inventory Setup, Inventory Posting Setup, Item Posting Groups, Units of Measure and Items read-only in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
No setup, item, document, Preview Posting or Posting occurred in TARGET-040.
The next run must start with a fresh Smart Decision Card before clicking New on Items.
acceptanceCriteria: playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE is confirmed before any New action.
The Items list is captured before the write.
The New item route is captured with screenshot QA and dangerous dialogs are blocked.
At most one item is saved, or the route is blocked with a clear reason.
If saved, the item is reopened by list/card proof and the approved fields are visible.
No setup value, posting group, VAT group, document, Preview Posting, Posting or API shortcut is used.
Result JSON classifies the item as created, blocked, or partially completed with a narrow next step.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-040 proved item/inventory pages read-only but did not prove a Base Unit value or item creation.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: The item write gate was still the right next step, but it correctly stopped because a safe Base Unit prerequisite is missing.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: A controlled base-unit setup/master-data gate is the narrow prerequisite before retrying the first item.
Needed only if a base unit exists but item-card field filling remains ambiguous.
Useful after item creation or after the base-unit blocker is resolved.
O2C still needs item, posting groups, VAT and expected entry trace boundaries.

nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: A base unit is the smallest missing prerequisite for a trustworthy first item.
risksBeforeNextCase: Creating a unit of measure changes setup-like master data and needs its own Smart Decision.
A later item save must not set posting groups casually.
No document, Preview Posting or Posting is allowed from this foundation gate.
requiredPreparation: Define one Base Unit code for Universaarl, likely STK or PCS, and explain it in beginner language.
Keep posting groups and VAT fields untouched.

proved: Business Central stayed in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Units of Measure and Items were inspected before the item write.
The first item was not saved because the required Base Unit route was not safe enough.
notProved: No item master data persistence is proven unless resultStatus is observed.
No Base Unit is selected on a saved item.
No Item Posting Group, Gen. Prod. Posting Group or VAT Prod. Posting Group is proven on an item.
No sales, purchase, inventory, Preview Posting, Posting, item ledger entry, value entry, G/L entry or VAT entry is proven.
Units of Measure page did not show PCS or STK. The first item was not saved because Base Unit would be unproven.
No U-ITEM-HW100 item is visible after filtered reopen.
blockedBy: Units of Measure page did not show PCS or STK. The first item was not saved because Base Unit would be unproven.
No U-ITEM-HW100 item is visible after filtered reopen.
warnings: This is a first item gate, not inventory or O2C/P2P readiness.
An empty Units of Measure surface blocks a trustworthy item save.
Posting/VAT/inventory posting fields remain separate gated setup steps.
